text:
anya: Heads-up 1: were rolling a compatibility change: rename `batch_size` -> `batch` and tighten delegated auth to require `x-rw-user`. Need partner-safe rollout covering marketplace connectors and hardware-embedded SDKs. Ideas?

ben: Can we do header negotiation so partners opt-in? If they send `X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: 2` we accept `batch` + new auth. Otherwise v1 behavior.

ike: Yep. Plan: feature-flag + header. Also stand up a test host `compat-v2-test.redwood.ai` for partner smoke tests.

claire: SRE requests an edge-shim that translates `batch` -> `batch_size` for non-opt-ins for a limited window. Also add metrics `compat.header_seen`, `compat.translation` and `compat.auth_fail`. I'll wire dashboards and alerts.

sandra: Marketplace note: connectors often auto-promote. We need a badge/status and a small blurb partners can paste into their listing telling users how to test. We can prevent auto-promotion until partner confirms.

hw-partner-rep: Hardware partners freeze SDKs in firmware. We likely need an extended window for them (60-90 days) or a binary shim. Edge-shim tagging by partner ID would help.

anya: Proposed minimal rollout:
- Day 0: announce + partner survey (marketplace + hw)
- Day 2: test host + samples + opt-in form
- Day 7: start opt-in canary (mix of connectors + 2 hw partners)
- Day 14: enable edge shim for non-opt-ins (default 30d, extendable)
- Day 45: soft deprecate v1 auth telemetry sweep
- Day 75+: final removal for general partners; hardware handled case-by-case

ben: Docs owner? I'll draft migration snippets (curl/python/node) and a quick SI checklist (grep for `batch_size`, hardcoded auth header).

claire: I'll own SRE runbook: thresholds, auto-pause per-partner, rollback steps. Set page if auth_fail > 0.75% or error delta > 1% for 10m.

sandra: I'll add marketplace badge endpoint and hold off promotions until partners confirm. Office hours Day 3 + Day 10.

hw-partner-rep: I'll start collecting impacted firmware partners and prioritize ones with >10k devices. Optionally request binary shim from eng.

ike: Quick sample (curl):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-SDK-Compat: 2" \
  https://compat-v2-test.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"batch":8}'

anya: Owners recap: comms & survey: anya; samples & SI checklist: ben; marketplace coord & badge: sandra; edge shim + monitoring: claire; eng + test host: ike; hw liaison: hw-partner-rep. I'll send partner mail tonight and post migration guide in the partner repo. Thanks all :thumbsup:
